I recently attended the Landscape Photography Devon Workshop with Mr. Alan Ranger, and it was an outstanding experience from start to finish. The workshop was well-organized, with a detailed schedule and excellent information about each location — including the best times for sunrise, sunset, high tide, and low tide. Everything we needed to know was clearly explained and thoughtfully planned.  The choice of locations was perfect for training and practice. Each spot offered unique opportunities to experiment with composition, light, and timing. I must admit, I learned a lot of useful techniques, creative ideas, and ways to think differently about each shot — especially the importance of being patient and waiting for the right moment.  There were only three of us in total, which made the experience even more personal and interactive. I also learned a great deal from my fellow participants. The commuting distances between locations were short and comfortable, and Alan proved to be not only an excellent tutor but also an excellent driver!  Overall, this workshop was both educational and inspiring. I’m truly grateful for the experience and hope to join Alan again for more workshops in other locations.

review.reviewBody: My wife and I want to offer our highest recommendations for Alan Ranger’s workshop in Anglesey, Wales. Technical questions were certainly addressed, but the core of the workshop was concerned with how to best represent the beauty that we saw. And we saw a great deal of beauty. I'm sure that anyone from beginners like ourselves upwards would enjoy and benefit from Alan's expertise if not from attending a course just reading his blog which we find excellent.
Highly recommended! Alan really gets you thinking about your photography and puts his knowledge across in a way that's easy to understand

I was given a place on one of Alan's courses as a gift and found it very informative and worthwhile.  Alan has not only excellent presentation skills, but he had prepared the event with some thought, for instance arranging the seating to allow people with similar hardware to sit near to each other.  He changed my views on how I should be taking my hobby forward.

I've wanted a 'proper' camera (ie. A DSLR) for a long time and I got one for Christmas. I love it, but have no idea how to use all the settings to get the best out of it, so after seeing the 'photography made easy' course online, I decided to book onto it.     I found out after booking that the course was a 'lecture' format so I was a bit skeptical, thinking that I probably wouldn't learn a whole lot. I was completely wrong! Although it's not practical, it is really interactive and Alan encourages lots of participation, questions, thoughts etc. The course covers the basics of aperture, shutter speed, ISO etc. necessary for you to go home and experiment, knowing what all the settings on the camera dial are. Alan was very patient and didn't mind explaining numerous times what certain things are when the class for confused!    I enjoyed the course very much and I have now signed up to the extended course, because I believe I will greatly benefit from doing practical work with Alan. Thank you very much!
